explanation: This is a broad previous-token copy/continuation head: it attends to the previous token (weights 0.7-0.97) with a near-perfect copying OV circuit, so ordinary prose made of single-token words is active-weak (just above the line, e.g. max ~0.9 on plain sentences). It fires STRONGLY (2-3x the active line) on tokens that continue or complete a multi-token word, proper name, or fixed string (e.g. the 'ous' of treasonous, the 'ski' of Swarovski, the '.com' of washingtonpost.com). Single-word utterances such as 'Yes.', 'No.' or 'Stop.' (16/16 measured) sit at zero and are the defensible inactive class.
